bulletin.title: Penn State University Bulletin - Penn State Behrend (majors and campus facts)

test_policy.notes: Penn State first-year applicants may choose whether to self-report SAT/ACT scores through MyPennState; no superscoring and ACT Science is not accepted. The Behrend CDS C8A agrees: not required, considered if submitted.

requirements.notes: Penn State application fee is $75 for international applicants ($65 domestic). Application is the same for all Penn State campuses; the Behrend campus site returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so deadlines, English minimums and fee are the university-wide Undergraduate Admissions rules and should be confirmed with Penn State Behrend Admissions. Behrend CDS C7: GPA very important, rigor important; essay, recommendations, interview not considered. Penn State Behrend (Erie) offers nearly fifty degrees across the Black School of Business (AACSB-accredited), School of Engineering, sciences, humanities and nursing; the Bulletin says about 75 percent of students finish their degree there and others do the first two years before changing campus. It runs an English Language Study Center for multicultural learners.

deadlines.label: Early Action (university-wide)
deadlines.notes: Apply by Nov 1 to receive a decision by Dec 24. The Behrend CDS (C22) lists the same Nov 1 closing and Dec 24 notification dates.

deadlines.label: Recommended submission deadline for all applications
deadlines.notes: Dec 1 is a recommended date, not a hard closing date: the Behrend CDS (C14) reports no application closing date and admission is rolling. No regular-decision notification date is published on the page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: University-wide rule. Required of international applicants whose native language is not English (US citizens and permanent residents are exempt). Alternatives: SAT EBRW 570+ (code 2660), ACT English 24+ (code 3656), GCSE/GCE English language A-C, IB English A 5+, four years at a US high school, or certification from Penn State's Intensive English Communication Program (IECP). Test scores must be under two years old; TOEFL MyBest is not accepted.

aid.notes: Penn State states there is essentially no financial aid available for international undergraduate students, and the Behrend CDS (H6) reports no institutional aid for nonresidents.

tier_notes.general: Admits about 96% of applicants (91% of international applicants) but the enrolled profile (average GPA 3.41, SAT middle 50% of 1150-1320 among submitters) is stronger than most open-access campuses, and the degree carries the Penn State name.
tier_notes.engineering: The University Bulletin describes Behrend's School of Engineering as ranked among the top 40 undergraduate engineering programs nationwide, with ABET-accredited engineering and engineering technology programs; the ranking list is not named, so C (41-100 nationally) is a cautious editorial placement.
